sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 is a strong agentic coding model built for long-running, multi-step work. It deeply understands your codebase, holds the thread across complex tasks, and pins down requirements for feature development and bug-fixing more effectively than Opus 4.8.

sources.title: JadePuffer agentic attacks now target AI model data with ransomware
sources.snippet: The JadePuffer autonomous AI agent has upgraded with custom malware called EncForge that focuses on encrypting AI assets, such as training datasets, vector databases, and model checkpoints.
